cards.power: A Stand-Alone Expansion for the Krazy Kayfabizarro Komik Kard Klub

cards.lore: Listen up, Marks! History is a Work. Folklore is a Shoot. Grab your scissors, cut the lines, and don't let the plot-holes bite. Stay Fluffy!
cards.power: KAYFABE IS REAL
GAME MECHANIC: Replace HP with SoD (Suspension of Disbelief). If you stop buying the story, you lose the match.
WARNING: Contains traces of existential dread, botched spots, and unauthorized magic. Not fluffle for lost souls.

cards.lore: THE HEEL PROMOTER: He thinks the roster is disposable. He's wrong. Power: 100.
cards.power: The Pink Slip. One night, one match. If you bore me, you're buried permanently.

cards.lore: TOP FACE BOOKER: She's turning the shoot into a work to save the locker room. Power: 99.
cards.power: The Promo. My words are a crossbody into your heart. I've got a thousand nights of heat in the tank.

cards.lore: THE VALET: She keeps the heat alive when the main event drags. Power: 90.
cards.power: Ringside Distraction. Sister, tell him the one about the apples! We aren't tapping out tonight!

cards.lore: THE MANAGER TURNED REFEREE: Caught between the Bull and the Fox. Power: 50.
cards.power: The Reluctant Three-Count. I'm just following orders. Please... just one more night for the kid?

cards.lore: Formerly working dark matches in a cave. Now in the Main Event. Power: 20 (+80 w/ Lamp).
cards.power: The Push. Gains +10 Power for every 'Treasure' card in play.

cards.lore: THE HEEL MANAGER who scouted the talent, only to get screwed out of the commission. Power: 75.
cards.power: Gimmick Infringement. Can steal an Artifact card from any Face character.

cards.lore: Sentient brass. The ultimate Foreign Object. Power: INF.
cards.power: Cosmic Heat. Summons a Genie Token (95 Power). Three wishes, No DQ.

cards.lore: She doesn't want the Vizier's son; she wants the guy with the blue giant in his corner. Power: 50.
cards.power: The Valet's Gambit. Protects Aladdin from Manager effects for 3 turns.

cards.lore: Seven voyages, seven stipulations. He bumps like a maniac but always kicks out at two. Power: 60.
cards.power: The High Flyer. Immune to 'Ring Out' effects. Master of Selling.

cards.lore: A sentient arena that No-Sells the fire. Power: 85.
cards.power: Ring Collapse. The ring just dried. Good luck selling this to the crowd.

cards.lore: The ultimate vertical suplex machine. Power: 92.
cards.power: Ladder Match Hazard. Takes you to the clouds; no landing pad below.

cards.lore: High risk, high reward. The floor is literally knives. Power: N/A (Field).
cards.power: Razor Terrain. All characters take 10 damage per turn.

cards.lore: A cannibal Heel. He likes his Jobbers well-done. Power: 95.
cards.power: The Squash Match. Instantly destroys the lowest power character card.

cards.cardName: THE OLD MAN OF THE SEA
cards.lore: The backpack you can't take off. Tap out or black out. Power: 70.
cards.power: Infinite Chokehold. Attaches to an opponent; they cannot attack until this card is removed.

cards.lore: A Foreign Object used to break the submission hold. Power: Item.
cards.power: Dirty Finish. Forces the 'Old Man' card to detach/sleep.

cards.lore: The tour bus crashed. Everyone starts from zero. Power: Field.
cards.power: Hard Reset. Destroys all equipped items in play.

cards.lore: A woodcutter who found the master script. He's taxing the gold and the push. Power: 30.
cards.power: The Opportunist. Draw 3 cards if 'Magic Cave' is in play.

cards.lore: She marked your coffins. The dance ends when the dagger hits. Power: 90.
cards.power: Hardcore Valet. Destroys 'Thief' tokens instantly.

cards.lore: Forgot his lines. Trapped in the cage with forty monsters. Power: 10.
cards.power: The Botch. Destroyed if you don't play a 'Password' card.

cards.lore: The ultimate gated community. Power: Field.
cards.power: Steel Cage. No one enters or leaves without the 'Voice Gimmick'.

cards.lore: Not here for gold. Here for the Heat. Power: 40 (+40).
cards.power: Stable Leader. +5 Power for every Thief Token in play.

cards.lore: Token swarm. Individually weak, collectively a burial squad. Power: Swarm.
cards.power: Zerg Rush. Overwhelms single target blockers.

cards.lore: They tried to mark the house. Morgiana marked the whole block. Power: Effect.
cards.power: Mind Games. Confuses the target; 50% chance attack hits wrong target.

cards.lore: Hiding in the props department. A fatal mistake. Power: Trap.
cards.power: Boiling Point. If attacked, destroys the attacker.

cards.lore: The Tank Class. His contract is written in rust and cannot be rewritten. Power: 90.
cards.power: Iron Script. Immune to Poison/Bleed. Cannot be persuaded.

cards.lore: He doesn't care about your story. He points to the grave. Power: 75.
cards.power: Programmed Ref. Forces players to reveal their hands.

cards.lore: Top Draw of the silent era. Her promotion is dead, but she's still booking. Power: 80.
cards.power: Eternal Stare. Paralyzes one character for 2 turns.

cards.lore: Read the spoilers. Leave the city. Power: Artifact.
cards.power: The Script. Reveals the next 3 cards in the deck.

cards.lore: They believed the story so much they became the set. Power: Field hazard.
cards.power: Dead Crowd. No 'Pop' bonuses can be earned here.

cards.lore: The original Promoter's trap. Even the big guys can't break this contract. Power: Artifact.
cards.power: The Prison. Traps a Genie card permanently in discard.

cards.lore: Loudmouth on the mic. Screaming promos for centuries. Power: Effect.
cards.power: Sonic Attack. Discards opponent's hand.

cards.lore: Don't look down. The height is a work, the fall is a shoot. Power: Ring Out.
cards.power: Suicide Dive. Rolling a 1 causes self-destruction.

cards.lore: Mastered the screws. You can't hit what you can't reach. Power: 70.
cards.power: Aerial Assault. Bypasses 'Guard' cards.

cards.lore: A mechanical work that looks like magic. Power: Mount.
cards.power: Tech Gimmick. Grants +50 Power and 'Flying'.

cards.lore: Heel Inventor. He built the trap. You're just a kid in his saddle. Power: 55.
cards.power: Sabotage. Removes 'Flying' from opponent; causes crash.

cards.lore: Not crazy; just cutting the best promo of her life to avoid the stable. Power: 45.
cards.power: Insanity Promo. Cannot be 'Married' (captured) by Heels.

cards.lore: One night of wind, ten years of shame. A footnote in a mother's calendar. Power: 15.
cards.power: The Wind of Fate. Cannot return to board if 'Calendar' is in play.

cards.lore: A biological accident is as damaging as a steel chair. Power: Status Effect.
cards.power: Cheap Heat. Generates heat for the opponent; exiles Abu Hasan.

cards.lore: The prop body. Tag! You're the killer. Power: 0.
cards.power: The Ref Bump. When played, triggers 'Blame Game'.

cards.lore: A tiny foreign object. The ultimate No-Sell. Power: Weapon.
cards.power: Choking Hazard. Causes temporary 'Death' state.

cards.lore: Tripped in the dark. This isn't medical school; it's a crime scene. Power: 40.
cards.power: Panic Turn. Transfers 'Guilt Token' to adjacent card.

cards.lore: Just wanted to fix the body so no one would notice. Power: 30.
cards.power: Stitching the Squash. Returns destroyed card as 'Zombie'.

cards.lore: Thought the corpse was a burglar. Worked himself into a shoot. Power: 35.
cards.power: Drunken Brawl. Attacks blindly.

cards.lore: The Talker. He saves the day by annoying everyone to death. Power: 25.
cards.power: Filibuster. Delays execution phase by talking forever.

cards.lore: THE COMMISSIONER. He wanders the streets to catch you breaking rules. Power: 95.
cards.power: Disguised Audit. Look at opponent's hand; discard one Heel card.

cards.lore: THE GRAND VIZIER. He cleans up the Caliph's mess. Power: 85.
cards.power: The Enforcer. Destroys 'Corruption' cards.

cards.lore: THE PROMO WRITER. His segments are legendary, if he shows up sober. Power: 60.
cards.power: Witty Verse. Boosts Face character power by +30.

cards.lore: When he steps in, the storyline ends. Power: Finisher.
cards.power: The Bell. Ends the match instantly if King orders it.

cards.lore: Don't open it. The smell isn't gold; it's a botched finish. Power: 0.
cards.power: Dead Wait. Transforms into 'Mutilated Body' after 3 turns.

cards.lore: One apple for a life. A fair trade in a nonsensical world. Power: 20.
cards.power: Clue Gimmick. Protects Vizier from execution.

cards.lore: Saw the apple, saw red. No one gets a happy ending. Power: 65.
cards.power: Blinded Rage. Attacks nearest character (friend or foe).

cards.lore: Took the apple, took the heat. Power: 10.
cards.power: Scapegoat. Takes damage intended for another card.

cards.lore: The currency of the realm. Keep the marks believing. Power: Meter.
cards.power: The Sell. You must 'Sell' Bizarro effects or lose the game.

cards.lore: Massive Heat. Unfair reset. The boss wins. Power: Riser!
cards.power: Pull Strings. Steals opponent of Title/Artifact without a clean finish.

cards.lore: The only defense against the Executioner. Power: Defense.
cards.power: To Be Continued... Stops a 'Death' blow; match resumes next night.

cards.lore: To lose the mask is to lose your soul. Keep it on. Power: Equipment.
cards.power: True Face. Prevents identity reveals.
